Heart rate is the number of heart beats per minute while a person is at rest. The normal range is 60 to 100 bpm, which can vary with age, gender, and other physiological factors. Generally, the younger an individual is, the higher the heart beat will be. It is normal that the elderly and the male have lower heart rates than the young and the female. An adult\'s normal resting heart rate ranges from 60 to 100 bpm, while the ideal range is 55 to 70 bpm. Compared with ordinary grown-ups, athletes\' hearts beat is noticeably lower, at about 50 bpm.
